chunks: Yet now (that it has come) they refuse to believe in it; but they will come to know soon.

key_terms.بِهِ: In it (referring to the truth or Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'fasawfa ya'lamun' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who reject the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Imams, emphasizing that their denial is not final but will be exposed on the Day of Judgment. It serves as a warning that the 'knowledge' they will gain is not mere intellectual acknowledgment but a painful realization of the truth they deliberately ignored, aligning with the concept of *Haqq al-Yaqin* (certainty of truth).
